text: ok you gotta look at the other things around it doing the same thing and solve the problem not avoid it [Image #1][Image #2] both of these u can see dont even fit in view, the blue expanded area doesnt have a right hand edge, its just overflowing, all the way  through, and you solved 1 of the many problems
resolution: Fixed the root shared workbench picker overflow instead of treating one building field at a time. Open pick fields now render as full-width vertical blocks with the label above the chooser, so the chooser is no longer laid out beside a 104px label gutter. PickerChooser now uses bounded containers, a local bounded TextInput, bounded option rows, and one-line option labels so the blue expanded area keeps its right edge inside the properties column. Verified focused buildings suite and full hmsc-int bundle.
